name: Maggran's Reserve Letter
summary: Maggran's Reserve Letter is an official dispatch written by Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat. Carried across Kalimdor to the Great Lift, it grants a stationed sentry long-awaited relief so he may return home to visit his family.

sections.title: A Sentry Relieved
sections.body: Maintaining outposts across the rugged expanse of Kalimdor demands vigilance, but the leaders of the Horde recognize that prolonged watch duty takes a heavy toll on morale. Penned by Maggran Earthbinder in the high crags of Sun Rock Retreat, this simple missive serves as official orders notifying Grish Longrunner that a replacement warrior has been dispatched to take over his post at the Great Lift. For a lonely guard watching over the towering wooden winches far to the south, the letter promises something rare in troubled times: an honorable leave of absence to reunite with family.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Maggran's Reserve Letter?
faq.answer: The letter contains official orders from Maggran Earthbinder relieving the sentry Grish Longrunner from his post at the Great Lift in the southern Barrens, allowing him to return home and visit his family.
The letter was written by Maggran Earthbinder, an elder residing at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Who is meant to receive it?
faq.answer: It is addressed to Grish Longrunner, a Horde guard stationed at the top of the Great Lift connecting the southern Barrens to Thousand Needles.
It must be carried south across the Barrens to the edge of the Thousand Needles canyon, where the Great Lift stands.

angles.text: The missive highlights the Horde's post-war efforts to care for its scattered forces by cycling fresh reserves into remote outposts across Kalimdor.
